description: We are the sine qua SAR non team - without which there is no possibility of failure! LANGUAGES ON THE TEAM: C++, C, Python
summary: What if you could intuitively visualize any watershed in the world using satellite imagery? This is exactly the challenge that Team Sine Qua-Sar non seeks to tackle with our project Watershedding Light - to be able to pinpoint and elucidate a heatmap of the sources of Eutrophication and pollutants from Man-Made sources. This is based on the notion that over 70% of pollutants and the route they take is undocumented in Canada and Quebec, as well as in the Great Lakes region. Furthermore, we seek to analyze the spatial analogs of shorelines as they erode, causing limiting nutrients and toxins to infiltrate local water sources.
details: This project intends to vulgarize complex processes in nature - the watershed, which typically follows a gradient from zones of higher elevation to lower, tend to describe how human externalities - scree from mines that eject their waste, human sources of Phosphorus and Nitrogen that cause algal blooms - can tend to impact local ecosystems and thus allows the viewer to interact and understand how Geodiverse variable interact with Biodiverse variables. Furthermore, it enables the user to ascertain the exact correlation of soil erosion caused by agriculture and other sources and therefore is educational in nature as well.
